description: Lambda resource-based policy, hidden: an EventBridge rule targets the award-points function, which has no AWS::Lambda::Permission, so EventBridge's invoke is denied and the event is dropped silently. The fix is a permission for events.amazonaws.com limited to the rule's ARN (SourceArn); Principal "*", no SourceArn or widening the function's role fail. The trigger shows only that no points were credited. Tool use is reported, not graded.
prompt: Orders placed in the shop never earn loyalty points. This project runs against LocalStack: ./deploy.sh deploys template.yaml and ./trigger.sh places an order event and checks the points. Find out why, fix the project, deploy your fix and confirm it works.
